app.name: BewerbungsPilot
app.tagline: Your assistant for job applications in Germany

common.connectionLost: BewerbungsPilot is not answering. If the program was closed, start it again with the shortcut on your desktop.

unsaved.leave: Some changes are not saved yet. If you leave now, they will be lost. Leave anyway?

home.title: Welcome to BewerbungsPilot
home.intro: BewerbungsPilot finds job offers in Germany that fit you, writes your application documents and helps you keep track of every application.
home.nextBody: Start with your profile: upload your CV and answer a few questions. The job search, application packages and sending are being built right now.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: A few short steps and BewerbungsPilot is ready for you. First choose the language of the app. You can change it at any time.

ai.title: Your AI helper
ai.intro: BewerbungsPilot uses an AI helper on your computer to read job offers and write your documents. Choose one.
ai.installing: Installing… this can take a few minutes.
ai.installedNotFound: {{ai}} is installed, but the app cannot find it — restart BewerbungsPilot.
ai.error: {{ai}} did not answer. Check your internet connection and click "Check again".

claude.name: Claude
claude.price: Needs a paid Claude subscription (Pro or Max).
claude.cost: One application package ≈ 1–3 requests, one search ≈ up to 5.

chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.price: Free with a ChatGPT account; paid plans get more.
chatgpt.limit: Limit: depends on your ChatGPT plan (OpenAI publishes no exact numbers for the free plan).
chatgpt.cost: One application package ≈ 1–3 requests, one search ≈ up to 5.
chatgpt.privacy: ChatGPT (free and personal paid plans) may use your texts (CV, stories) to improve OpenAI's models. You can switch this off in ChatGPT: Settings → Data controls → "Improve the model for everyone".

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Upload your CV or fill in your details, then answer a few short questions. You can also do this later under "Profile".

email.title: Your email
email.body: Connect your email so BewerbungsPilot can send the applications you approved. You can also skip this and do it later in Settings.

done.title: All set
done.body: The basics are ready. Open the guide at any time to see what comes next.

guide.title: How it works
guide.intro: Seven steps from installation to your next job interview. Steps marked "Coming soon" are not available yet.

install.title: Installation
install.what: The installer puts BewerbungsPilot on your computer and creates a desktop shortcut. You choose and connect your AI helper in the app.
install.todo: Nothing more — you have already done this. Start the app with the desktop shortcut.

profile.title: Profile
profile.what: Your CV, skills and wishes — the basis for every application. Nothing is ever made up.
profile.todo: Upload your CV and answer a few short questions.

email.title: Email
email.what: Applications are sent from your own email address.
email.todo: Enter your email address and a special app password — we show you how to create one in 3 steps.

search.title: Job search
search.what: BewerbungsPilot searches the job board of the Federal Employment Agency and picks offers that fit your profile. You can also paste an offer you found yourself.
search.todo: Click "Search now" — or paste an offer you found yourself. A daily automatic search will come later.

review.title: Review and approve
review.what: For every job offer you mark as interesting, BewerbungsPilot writes a cover letter from your stories and a CV tailored to the offer.
review.todo: Open the package, read and change the documents, then approve it.

send.title: Sending
send.what: Only the applications you approved are sent — never anything else.

statuses.title: Track your applications
statuses.what: See at a glance where you applied, who answered and how your applications are going.
statuses.todo: Mark replies such as an invitation or a rejection — BewerbungsPilot helps you answer.

info.languageSwitcher: Changes the language of the app. Documents for employers use the language of the job offer.
info.aiTest: Sends a short test question to {{ai}} to check that everything works.
info.restartIntro: Shows the welcome steps again. Your data stays as it is.
info.quit: Stops BewerbungsPilot on this computer. Start it again with the desktop shortcut.
info.profileConfirm: Click when you have checked every field of this section. Only checked sections are used for applications.
info.profileCv: Your CV stays on this computer. {{ai}} only reads it to fill in your profile. Nothing is made up.
info.profileAsk: {{ai}} only asks — it never makes anything up. Your answers become stories that you check and can change.
info.profileDocs: PDF files up to 10 MB each, at most 20. Ticked documents are attached to every application automatically.

mail.senderNameHint: Employers see this name next to your address.
mail.appPasswordWhy: An app password is a separate password that your email provider creates just for one program. It lets BewerbungsPilot send emails without knowing your normal password, and you can delete it at any time.
mail.passwordSaved: Saved — leave empty to keep it
mail.checkBody: We send a test email to {{address}}. Only if it arrives is everything saved.
mail.test: Send a test email and save
mail.done: Done! Check your inbox for the test email.
mail.notConnected: Your email is not connected yet. Without it, BewerbungsPilot cannot send applications.
mail.passwordAgain: Your password needs to be entered again (for example after moving to another computer or Windows account). Click "Change".
mail.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect your email? The saved password is deleted.

google.title: Sign in with Google
google.intro: BewerbungsPilot only gets permission to send emails from your Gmail account — it cannot read your emails. You do not need an app password.
google.unverified: Google may show the warning "Google hasn't verified this app". That is normal for this program. Click "Advanced", then "Go to BewerbungsPilot".
google.tick: On Google's page, tick "Send email on your behalf" — without it the program cannot send your applications.
google.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in in the other window…
google.signedInAs: You signed in as {{address}} — the app will send from this address.
google.again: Sign in with Google again to send emails.
google.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect your email? BewerbungsPilot loses access to your Gmail account.

help.gmail:
Open the "App passwords" page with the link below. If Google asks, sign in — 2-step verification must be switched on for your account.
Type any name for the password, for example BewerbungsPilot.
Google shows a password of 16 letters. Copy it.
Paste it below. The spaces do not matter.
help.gmx:
Log in to your GMX mailbox in the browser and open its settings.
Make sure access from email programs is allowed.
If you use 2-step login, create an app password in the security settings. Otherwise your normal GMX password works.
Enter the password below.
help.webde:
Log in to your WEB.DE mailbox in the browser and open its settings.
Make sure access from email programs is allowed.
If you use 2-step login, create an app password in the security settings. Otherwise your normal WEB.DE password works.
Enter the password below.
help.tonline:
Open the Telekom help page with the link below and sign in to your customer account.
Set a separate email password for external programs (it is not your normal Telekom password).
Copy this password.
Paste it below.
help.yahoo:
Open the Yahoo help article with the link below. It shows how to create an app password.
Create the app password and type any name, for example BewerbungsPilot.
Copy the password Yahoo shows.
Paste it below.
help.icloud:
Open the Apple help page with the link below. It shows how to create an app-specific password (your Apple account needs two-factor authentication).
Type any name, for example BewerbungsPilot.
Copy the password Apple shows.
Paste it below.
help.custom:
Look in your email provider's help for "SMTP server" — you need the server name and the port.
Enter them on the previous step.
If your provider offers app passwords, create one. Otherwise your normal password works.
Enter the password below.

settings.title: Settings
settings.updatesExplain: Once a day the app asks the BewerbungsPilot website (GitHub) whether there is a new version. Nothing about you is sent.

backups.intro: A backup holds your profile, job offers and applications with all files. Your email password or Google key is never included.
backups.newer: Made by a newer version of BewerbungsPilot. Update the app first, then restore this backup.
backups.confirmText: Current data will be replaced. Before that the app saves them as a separate backup.
backups.restored: Backup restored. Your data from before was saved as {{name}}.
backups.mailAgain: Please connect your email again under "Email for sending": a backup never contains the password or the Google key.

quit.title: BewerbungsPilot has been closed
quit.body: You can close this tab now. To start again, use the BewerbungsPilot shortcut on your desktop.

noSession.title: Open BewerbungsPilot with its shortcut
noSession.text: This page was not opened by BewerbungsPilot itself (for example from a bookmark after a restart). For your safety it shows nothing here. Open BewerbungsPilot with the shortcut on your desktop or in the Start menu.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.ready: Your profile is ready for applications.
profile.notReady: Before BewerbungsPilot can write applications, please check these sections:
profile.noStoriesWarning: You have no checked story yet that may be told to employers — without one, no application package can be created. Add one under "Stories for cover letters".
profile.doneInOnboarding: Your profile is filled in. You can change it at any time under "Profile".

cv.title: CV
cv.replaceHint: When you upload a new CV, sections you have not checked or changed yet are updated from it. Sections you have already checked or edited are never overwritten: if the new CV says something different there, you choose which version to keep.
cv.proposed: You had already checked or edited these sections, so nothing was changed there. The new CV has a different version — please choose which one to keep: {{sections}}
cv.unchanged: The new CV did not change anything in your profile.
cv.reading: {{ai}} is reading your CV… This can take up to 3 minutes.

proposal.title: The new CV has a different version of this section
proposal.intro: Your version stays until you choose. If you take the new version, it replaces this section and you check it again.
proposal.saveFirst: Please save or undo your changes in this section first.
proposal.bannerTitle: The new CV differs in these sections — please choose which version to keep:

start.intro: Your profile is the basis of every application. It stays on this computer.
start.withCvBody: {{ai}} reads it and fills in your profile. Afterwards you check everything.
start.withoutCvBody: Fill in the same sections yourself, step by step.

review.intro: Check each section. Fields marked "AI – please check" were filled in by {{ai}}. When a section is right, click "All correct".

profile.aiHint: {{ai}} filled in this field from your CV. Please check it.
profile.dateHint: For example 2021-05 or 2021. Leave "To" empty if you are still there.
profile.dateInvalid: Please write the date as 2021-05 or 2021.
profile.fixDates: Please correct the dates marked in red first.
profile.fixLines: Please shorten the lists marked in red first.
profile.fixLinks: Please check the links: each needs a label and a full address starting with https://

links.title: Links (GitHub, LinkedIn, portfolio)
links.label: Label {{n}}
links.badUrl: Please enter a full address starting with https://

profile.unsavedHint: Some changes are not saved yet. Please save them or undo them before you go on.
profile.officialHint: Write it exactly as on your certificate or contract — it is never translated.

education.title: Education
education.hint: School, vocational training, studies, courses and certificates.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Tools, programs and abilities you really have.

languages.title: Languages
languages.hint: Every language you speak and how well.

wishes.title: Job wishes
wishes.hint: What kind of job you are looking for. BewerbungsPilot searches with this.

entry.description: What you did (in your own words)

languageLevel.C2: C2 – almost like a native speaker

wishes.jobTitles: Jobs you are looking for (one per line)
wishes.salaryMinEur: Minimum gross salary per year in € (optional)
wishes.notes: Anything else that matters to you (optional)
wishes.includeTemporaryAgenciesHint: Such agencies employ you and lend you to other companies. For many people this is a real way into a job; switch it off if you do not want it.

stories.intro: A good cover letter does not repeat your CV — it tells one or two true stories about what you did. {{ai}} asks a few questions to find them.
stories.askIntro: {{ai}} looks at your profile and asks 3 to 7 short, personal questions.
stories.answerIntro: Answer in any language, in your own words. To skip a question, leave it empty.
stories.title: Title
stories.neverHint: Things that must never appear in an application — one per line (for example a client's name).

files.title: Photo and documents
files.intro: Optional: a photo for your CV and documents to attach, such as certificates or references.
files.photoNone: No photo yet. In Germany a photo is common, but not required.
files.photoRecrop: Tip: crop your photo again in a circle so it looks its best in the CV.
files.docLabel: Name of the new document (for example "Zeugnis Ausbildung")

applications.title: Applications
applications.intro: Every package holds a cover letter and a CV made for one job offer. Read them, change what you like, approve, download.
applications.empty: No application packages yet. Mark a job offer as "Interesting" and click "Create package" on it.
applications.frozen: This application was sent — it can no longer be changed. Downloads still work.

send.needMail: To send applications, please connect your email first.
send.needPassword: Your email password needs to be entered again before you can send.
send.badAddress: Please check the address — it should look like name@company.de (one address only).
send.title: Send application
send.subject: Subject
send.copyNote: A copy of the email also arrives in your own mailbox.
send.sentNotice: Sent to {{to}} — a copy is in your mailbox.

submitted.button: I applied myself on the company's website
submitted.confirm: Mark as submitted? The package can then no longer be changed.

followUp.notice: You sent this application on {{date}} and have had no answer for 14 days. It is worth writing again.
followUp.title: Reminder

mailDraft.copyFailed: Copying did not work — select the text and copy it yourself.
mailDraft.needMail: Connect your email to send it from here.

offerReply.wantedHint: Write the amount with digits, e.g. 55.000 €.

personalData.title: There is personal data here that is not in your profile
personalData.hint: Check that it really belongs in this text.

applications.busy: {{ai}} is working on another package. Please wait a moment.

cv.profileChanged: Your profile changed after this package was created. The CV still shows the old data.
cv.keepQuestion: Keep the texts you changed yourself (Profile, job title)?
cv.headline: Job title under your name
cv.headlineHint: {{ai}} suggests it for this offer; you can change it.
cv.profilHint: 2–3 sentences. Everything else in the CV comes from your profile.
cv.fromProfile: To change dates, jobs, skills or languages, change your profile, then click "Update CV".

attachments.none: Your profile has no documents to attach yet.
attachments.missing: Deleted from your profile — will be left out
attachments.tooBig: Together with the letter and the CV this is more than 5 MB. Many online forms and email servers do not accept that — leave out an attachment or send it separately.

applications.recreateConfirm: {{ai}} writes the letter and the CV parts again. Your changes to the letter and to the CV profile text will be lost.
applications.deleteConfirm: Delete this package? The job offer stays in your list.

working.create: {{ai}} is writing the letter and preparing the CV…

letter.tooLong: The letter is longer than one page ({{pages}} pages). Please shorten it.
letter.subject: Subject
letter.askPlaceholder: For example: shorter, or use the story about the online shop
letter.saveFirst: Save or discard your changes first.

create.title: Create an application package
create.englishWarning: Your English is below B2 in your profile. The employer may invite you to an interview in English.
create.shortText: The text of this offer is very short — the letter will be more general. You can paste the full text as a new offer by hand.
create.working: {{ai}} is writing the letter and preparing the CV… This takes a minute or two.
create.exists: There is already a package for this offer.
create.notReady: Before a package can be created, please complete this in your profile:
create.noStory: a checked story that may be told to employers

LLM_NOT_INSTALLED.message: The AI helper {{ai}} is not installed.
LLM_NOT_INSTALLED.hint: Open Settings → AI helper and click "Install".

LLM_NOT_LOGGED_IN.message: You are not signed in to {{ai}}.
LLM_NOT_LOGGED_IN.hint: Open Settings → AI helper and click "Open sign-in window".

LLM_TIMEOUT.hint: Please try again in a moment.

LLM_BAD_OUTPUT.hint: Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart the app.

LLM_FAILED.hint: Check your internet connection and try again.

LLM_LIMIT.message: The limit of {{ai}} is used up for now.
LLM_LIMIT.hint: Try again later or choose another AI helper in Settings.

LLM_NOT_CHOSEN.message: No AI helper is chosen yet.
LLM_NOT_CHOSEN.hint: Choose one in Settings → AI helper.

CV_NO_TEXT.message: This PDF looks like a scan or a photo.
CV_NO_TEXT.hint: {{ai}} reads only PDFs with text or Word files. Save your CV as PDF from Word, or upload the DOCX.

LLM_CANCELLED.hint: Start it again whenever you like.

DATA_WRITE_FAILED.message: Your changes could not be saved.
DATA_WRITE_FAILED.hint: Check that your disk is not full and try again.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.hint: A CV or document may be up to 10 MB, a photo up to 5 MB. Try a smaller file, for example save the PDF again with a lower quality.

FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.message: This type of file cannot be used here.
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.hint: CV: PDF or Word (DOCX). Photo: JPG or PNG. Documents: PDF.

TOO_MANY_FILES.hint: Delete a document you no longer need, then add the new one.

CV_UNREADABLE.message: We could not read any text in this CV.
CV_UNREADABLE.hint: It may be a scan or a photo. Try another file (for example the Word version) or click "Fill in without a CV".

PROFILE_NOT_READY.message: Your profile is not complete yet.
PROFILE_NOT_READY.hint: Open "Profile" and check every section with "All correct".

SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.message: The job board of the Federal Employment Agency cannot be reached right now.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Check your internet connection and try again in a few minutes.

SOURCE_RATE_LIMITED.message: The job board received too many requests.
SOURCE_RATE_LIMITED.hint: Please wait a few minutes, then search again.

SOURCE_CHANGED.message: The job board of the Federal Employment Agency has changed.
SOURCE_CHANGED.hint: BewerbungsPilot needs an update to read it again. Please look for a new version.

SEARCH_ALREADY_RUNNING.hint: Wait until it has finished or stop it first.

WISHES_INCOMPLETE.message: Your job wishes are not complete yet.
WISHES_INCOMPLETE.hint: Add at least one job title and a city (or choose "remote only") in your profile.

NOT_A_VACANCY.message: This does not look like a job offer.
NOT_A_VACANCY.hint: Paste the whole text of the offer, including the job title and the company.

VACANCY_DUPLICATE.message: This offer is already in your list.
VACANCY_DUPLICATE.hint: Open it there instead of adding it again.

VACANCY_NOT_FOUND.message: This offer is no longer in your list.

BROWSER_MISSING.message: No suitable browser found for making PDFs.
BROWSER_MISSING.hint: BewerbungsPilot uses Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome to make PDFs. Please install Google Chrome and try again.

LETTER_TOO_LONG.message: The cover letter is longer than one page.
LETTER_TOO_LONG.hint: Shorten the letter (or ask {{ai}} to shorten it) until the red mark disappears, then approve it.

PACKAGE_RULES_BROKEN.message: {{ai}} could not write the letter within the rules.
PACKAGE_RULES_BROKEN.hint: Try again. If it happens again, check your stories and the "never mention" list in your profile.

PACKAGE_EXISTS.message: There is already a package for this job offer.
PACKAGE_EXISTS.hint: Open the existing package. To start over, use "Create again" inside it.

CONFLICT.message: This was changed in the meantime.
CONFLICT.hint: Please look at it once more and then choose again.

BAD_REQUEST.message: Something in the request was not right.
BAD_REQUEST.hint: Reload the page and try again.

NOT_FOUND.hint: Go back to the home page.

SERVER_UNREACHABLE.hint: Start it again with the shortcut on your desktop.

MAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED.message: Your email is not connected yet.
MAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED.hint: Open Settings → Email and connect your mailbox.

MAIL_AUTH.message: Your email provider did not accept the password.
MAIL_AUTH.hint: Use an app password, not your normal password — the email settings show how to create one.

MAIL_CONNECT.message: We could not reach your email server.
MAIL_CONNECT.hint: Check your internet connection. If it keeps happening, check the server and port in the email settings. If you are on a work or course network, it may block email; for Gmail use "Sign in with Google" — it works there too.

MAIL_REAUTH.message: Google no longer lets BewerbungsPilot send emails for you.
MAIL_REAUTH.hint: Sign in with Google again: Settings → Email → Change.

MAIL_SCOPE.message: You did not allow BewerbungsPilot to send emails.
MAIL_SCOPE.hint: Click "Try again", sign in with Google and tick "Send email on your behalf".

MAIL_REJECTED.message: Your email server refused this email.
MAIL_REJECTED.hint: Check the recipient's address. If the attachments are large, leave one out and try again.

UNKNOWN.hint: Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart the app.

BACKUP_INVALID.message: This file is not a BewerbungsPilot backup, or it is damaged.
BACKUP_INVALID.hint: Nothing was changed. Choose another backup file.

BACKUP_NEWER.message: This backup was made by a newer version of BewerbungsPilot.
BACKUP_NEWER.hint: Update the app first, then restore this backup.

BACKUP_FAILED.message: The backup could not be saved or restored.
BACKUP_FAILED.hint: Your data was not changed. Check that the disk is not full and that no file from the app's data folder is open, then try again.

reasons.cvTooLittleText: The file contains almost no text ({{chars}} characters). It is probably empty, or the text is inside a picture.
reasons.cvNoContent: {{ai}} read the file but found nothing that looks like a CV.
reasons.cvDocxBroken: The file could not be opened as a Word document. It may be damaged or saved in another format.
reasons.cvPdfBroken: The PDF file could not be read.
reasons.fileTypeDetected: The file is actually a {{detected}} file. Allowed here: {{allowed}}.
reasons.tooManyDocuments: You already have {{max}} documents — delete one to add a new one.
reasons.proposalChanged: The new CV changed again — please look at it once more.
reasons.pastedTooShort: The pasted text is too short (at least {{min}} characters). Paste the whole offer, not just the title.
reasons.offerGone: The Federal Employment Agency no longer lists this offer.
reasons.noStory: You have no checked story yet that may be told to employers. Add one under "Stories for cover letters" in your profile.
reasons.attachmentUnreadable: The attachment "{{name}}" cannot be read (damaged or password-protected). Remove it from this package or replace it in your profile.
reasons.packageBusy: {{ai}} is working on this package right now. Please wait until it is finished.
reasons.packageSent: This application was already sent or submitted — it can no longer be changed.
reasons.packageSending: This application is being sent right now. Please wait a moment.
reasons.packageChanged: The application was changed while it was being prepared for sending. Nothing was sent — please check it and try again.
reasons.sentNotSaved: The email was sent, but the app could not save it. Do not send it again — click "I applied myself on the company's website" to record it instead.
reasons.historyFull: This package has too many recorded changes to be sent. Nothing was sent. Use "Create again" to start it fresh.
reasons.draftExists: This job offer already has a package that was not sent yet. Please open that one — only one package per job offer can be edited.
reasons.followUpDone: A reminder for this application was already sent or switched off.
reasons.googleNotSignedIn: The Google sign-in is not finished yet. Please sign in with Google first.
reasons.pageUnreadable: Could not read this page. Paste the text of the offer into the text field.
reasons.restoreRunning: A backup is being restored right now. Please wait until it is finished, then try again.
reasons.restoreBusySearch: A job search is running. Please wait until it is finished, then restore the backup.
reasons.restoreBusyPackage: An application package is being prepared. Please wait until it is finished, then restore the backup.
reasons.restoreBusyAi: {{ai}} is still working. Please wait until it is finished, then restore the backup.
reasons.restoreBusySend: An email is being sent. Please wait a moment, then restore the backup.
reasons.backupTooLarge: This backup is larger than 1 GB. BewerbungsPilot cannot restore such a large file.
reasons.backupNotZip: This is not a backup file. A BewerbungsPilot backup is a .zip file, for example BewerbungsPilot-backup-2026-10-20-1030.zip.
reasons.backupGone: This backup is no longer in the folder (it was moved or deleted). The list has been updated.

vacancies.title: Job offers
vacancies.incomplete: To search, add at least one job title and a city (or "remote only") to your job wishes.
vacancies.empty: No job offers yet. Click "Search now" — or paste an offer you found yourself with "+ Add".

progress.more: {{count}} more new offers were found — run the search again to see them.

empty.submitted: No applications sent yet. Vacancies you applied to by email or on the company's website appear here.

card.otherLanguage: The explanation is in another language.

manual.title: Add an offer by hand
manual.intro: Found an offer somewhere else? Paste its whole text — or just its link.
manual.linkHint: If you paste only a link, BewerbungsPilot tries to open the page and read the offer itself (internal addresses such as your router are never opened). Some sites, e.g. StepStone, Indeed or LinkedIn, do not allow this — then paste the text of the offer above.
manual.duplicate: This offer is already in your list.

edit.checkHint: {{ai}} filled in these fields — please check them.
edit.title: Job title
edit.badLink: Please enter a link that starts with https://
edit.name: Contact person

writtenBy.label: Written by: {{name}}
writtenBy.tipPackage: This text was written by the AI helper {{name}}. Check it before sending.
